stem.text: A small charged sphere of mass $0.80\,\text{g}$ hangs from a light thread inside a vertical uniform electric field of strength $2000\,\text{V m}^{-1}$. The thread passes over two frictionless pulleys and a mass of $2.00\,\text{g}$ hangs on the other end.

stem.alt: Diagram of a vertical uniform electric field between a top plate marked with plus signs and a bottom plate marked with minus signs, with downward arrows. A charged sphere sits in the field and is attached by a thread over two pulleys to a mass on the right. Labels: pulleys; electric field of 2000 V m-1; charged sphere of mass 0.80 g; 2.00 g mass.
